exposure: Induced miscarriages due to fetal anomaly
Misoprostol administration according to the FIGO protocol
Induced miscarriages due to intrauterine fetal demise
Induced miscarriages due to medical problems
outcome: Successful expulsion of products of conception without surgical intervention
cohort: 73 patients admitted for medical termination of pregnancy.
finding: The FIGO protocol for Misoprostol administration was an effective and safe option for medical termination of pregnancy.
